content: fortune+cowsay+lolcat is the classic Unix chain: fortune pipes random quote to cowsay (ASCII cow speech bubble with -e/-f/-r flags for cow variants) which pipes to lolcat (rainbow gradient colorizer). These tools follow Unix pipe model perfectly: stdin->stdout, no interactivity. cowsay adds framing/border, lolcat adds rainbow color. fortune-cowsay combo is the most common .bashrc/profile greeting setup.
